newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber higher on improved demand.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber higher on improved demand.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were generally higher on Monday on improved demand, traders said.
They said Singapore buyers bought rubber at 48.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang and at 49.00 fob Medan on Friday, adding that quotations were higher in many centres on Monday.
"Offer prices are picking up because demand appears to be better recently. We hope to strike some deals in the afternoon," said one trader.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 48.50 fob Medan, 48.25 fob Palembang, 48.00 Padang and Surabaya and 47.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi.

Regional traders have said Southeast Asian rubber prices, bedevilled for weeks by poor consumption, are seen edging up on the back of fresh demand expected to come in ahead of the summer holiday season.
